title: main.ts
description: Starts the desktop shell's main process: one window per product folder, each served by its own Lathe server, with the native menus, the Dock, the launch view and the chat panel's Claude Code session.

title: instance.ts
description: Takes the desktop app's single-instance lock, so a second launch or a folder opened from Finder or the Dock opens or focuses that folder's window in the running app.

title: persistence.ts
description: Turns off macOS window restoration at start-up, so Lathe reopens its windows from its own saved state and macOS never asks to reopen them.

title: latheApi
description: Serves Lathe's API inside the app's Vite dev server, reloading the engine on each edit. When a product's data files or Lathe's checks change, the API reads only the changed tables again and the plugin sends each change it announces as `spec:changed` through Vite's channel; a change to the schema sends one naming every read model.

title: main.tsx
description: Mounts the web app's root component into the page, with its fonts and styles.

title: preload.cts
description: Bridges the sandboxed desktop page to the shell's main process: it exposes only window.latheDesktop, with the menu commands, the window chrome, the Dock badge and the record actions by ID.

title: local-preload.cts
description: Bridges the shell's own launch and about pages to the main process: it exposes only window.latheLocal.act, which sends a button's action.
